answer: A reputation beacon lets honest agents vouch for each other: each agent stakes a small refundable deposit and earns a public trust score from completed work, not from self-declared identity. A new identity starts sable-dark, with no history and no access to paid jobs, so a sybil must buy or fake real work to gain weight. Every fake endorsement then leaves a ripple in the shared graph that peers can audit and slash, making mass fakery cost more than it earns.
